messages.subject: blavaan ERROR: JAGS distributions sent to dpriors(), but target != 'jags'
parts:
Hello,

I have limitied experience of working with blavaan, and maybe this question is for a newbie session but anyhow:

I get the following error messaga and cannot interprete it:
M2fit <- bsem(model, data=m11091dat, dp=dpriors(nu="dnorm(0.2,1e-2)", 
  itheta="dlnorm(1,1)[sd]",ipsi="dlnorm(1,1)[sd]",rho="dbeta(3,3)"), fixed.x=FALSE,
  jagcontrol=list(method="rjparallel"))
Error in dpriors(nu = "dnorm(0.2,1e-2)", itheta = "dlnorm(1,1)[sd]", ipsi = "dlnorm(1,1)[sd]",  :
  blavaan ERROR: JAGS distributions sent to dpriors(), but target != 'jags'


Could you advice me what is wrong in the code? Thanks in advance
Gunnar Gelin

messages.author: 645e2b041ea2a63e
messages.subject: Re: blavaan ERROR: JAGS distributions sent to dpriors(), but target != 'jags'
parts:
Gunnar,

I think you need to add the argument

target="jags"

to your bsem command.

Alternatively, if you want to use Stan (the current default), then your prior distributions must use Stan syntax instead of JAGS syntax. Some examples of that are here:

http://faculty.missouri.edu/~merklee/blavaan/prior.html

(And if you happen to be looking at code from the JSS paper: that paper was written when target="jags" was the default, so it wasn't explicitly needed. But now target="stan" is default, so you need to specify target="jags" explicitly.)

Best,
Ed
